heading: Monday, April 14, 2025
topLine: 2 model releases: Zhipu AI GLM-4-32B-0414 / GLM-Z1 and OpenAI GPT-4.1.

items.headline: Zhipu AI releases GLM-4-0414 and GLM-Z1 reasoning models
items.summary: Zhipu released the open-weight GLM-4-32B-0414 series, including the GLM-Z1-32B and GLM-Z1-9B reasoning models and the GLM-Z1-Rumination deep-research model, alongside its new Z.ai domain. Zhipu claims GLM-Z1-32B matches DeepSeek-R1 on some tasks.

items.headline: OpenAI launches GPT-4.1, 4.1 mini and 4.1 nano in the API
items.summary: The API-only GPT-4.1 family supports up to 1 million tokens of context. OpenAI reported 54.6% on SWE-bench Verified (versus 33.2% for GPT-4o) and gains in instruction following.
